title: DECISION: adversarial backtracking test with timing bound
description: wildmat.rs includes a test (wildmat_no_catastrophic_backtracking) that specifically constructs the worst-case pattern for recursive backtracking ('*a*a*a*a*a*a*a*a*a' against 18 'a's followed by 'b'), runs the matcher, and asserts both the correct result and a wall-clock bound of <100ms. This test would catch any future regression to a recursive implementation. Most wildmat test suites only check correctness; this one also enforces the algorithmic complexity guarantee.
